Team Plasma: Wha...? How could we lose
when we have right on our side?!{VAR BE01}

Cheren: Not bad, {VAR 0100 0000}.
OK, go return the Pokémon to that girl.{VAR BE01}
You don't need to return it!{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: Pokémon Trainers
like you are making Pokémon suffer...{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: Someday, open your eyes
to your own complicity.{VAR BE01}

OK, {VAR 0100 0000},
I'll return the Pokémon.{VAR BE01}
